import java.util.Scanner;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        long base = a % MOD;
        long exp = p;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static boolean solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter pw, boolean multipleTestMode) {
        if (!sc.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        long ans;
        if (k == 0) {
            ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
        } else if (k == 1) {
            ans = fastPow(p, p);
        } else {
            long[] used = new long[(int)(p + 1)];
            ans = 1;
            for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
                if (used[(int)x] != 0) continue;
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
                used[(int)x] = 1;
                long v = x;
                while (used[(int)(v * k % p)] == 0) {
                    v = (v * k) % p;
                    used[(int)v] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(ans);
        return multipleTestMode;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        while (solve(sc, pw, true)) {
            // continue
        }
        pw.flush();
        sc.close();
    }
}
